items.title: The three taught verb groups
items.pattern: Group 1 / Group 2 / irregular する・来る
items.explanation: Learn the group together with each dictionary word. Group 2 drops る before て; Group 1 uses sound families. A final る alone does not determine the group: 帰る/座る are Group 1, 食べる/着る Group 2.

items.title: Group 1: う・つ・る → って
items.pattern: 会う→会って / 待つ→待って / 帰る→帰って
items.explanation: For taught Group 1 words ending う/つ/る, use って. This rule is distinct from Group 2's remove-る-plus-て pattern.

items.title: Group 1: む・ぶ・ぬ → んで
items.pattern: 読む→読んで / 遊ぶ→遊んで / 死ぬ→死んで
items.explanation: The explicitly taught sound family gives んで. 住む→住んで connects back to the earlier residence model.

items.title: Group 2 connecting form
items.pattern: 食べる→食べて / 着る→着て
items.explanation: For identified Group 2 words, remove final る and add て. Do not apply this to every word ending る.

items.title: Irregular する and 来る
items.pattern: する→して / 来る→来て
items.explanation: する gives して; 来るくる gives 来てきて. 勉強する→勉強して keeps the compound's noun part.

items.title: Group 1: く→いて; ぐ→いで
items.pattern: 書く→書いて / 泳ぐ→泳いで
items.explanation: The voiced ぐ family gives いで. 行く is the separately taught exception 行って.

items.title: Group 1: す→して; exception 行く
items.pattern: 話す→話して / 行く→行って
items.explanation: The す sound family gives して. 行く exceptionally gives 行って, not 行いて; distinguish written 行って and 言って despite shared sound いって.

items.title: Request an action: Vてください
items.pattern: 座ってください / 少し待ってください
items.explanation: Use the connecting te-form followed by ください. This extends the earlier noun request Nをください without conflating the two patterns.

items.title: Simple ordered action sequence
items.explanation: The connecting first form links ordered actions; the final polite verb carries the sentence's taught tense. Keep the supplied order and meaning.

items.title: Vehicle with 乗る
items.pattern: 電車 に 乗ります
items.explanation: The boarded/ridden vehicle takes に in this model; compare transport means で with 行く/帰る.

items.title: Current activity with Vています
items.pattern: 今、駅で本を読んでいます
items.explanation: Connecting form plus います describes current activity for the taught verbs. Nonpast 読みます can express habit; bare person います states existence.

items.title: Negative and past activity
items.pattern: Vていません / Vていました / Vていませんでした
items.explanation: These forms extend the taught progress model. Preserve て-form and change the polite います ending. Context distinguishes not-currently-doing from not-yet-completed use.

items.title: Still doing an activity
items.explanation: Positive ongoing activity with まだ means still doing in the supplied scene. It differs from not-yet completion with a negative.

items.title: Not yet completed
items.explanation: In the supplied completion question/answer, this says the action has not yet been completed. Compare short earlier まだです and もう + polite past for already completed action.

items.title: Explicit continuing states
items.pattern: 住んでいます / 着ています / 持っています
items.explanation: The supplied verbs describe residing, wearing, and holding/having states in context. Vています does not always translate as a current English -ing action.

items.title: Adverbial い-adjective form
items.pattern: 早い→早く / 遅い→遅く
items.explanation: Remove final い and add く to describe how/when the supplied action occurs. 早く here is early time, while assisted 速い describes speed.
